routes.name: Short skill training (CTEVT, 390 hours)
routes.about: Hands on courses in wiring, plumbing, mobile repair, tailoring, cooking and hospitality. Many are subsidised or free through CTEVT and local government schemes. A way to earn early, then return to study.

routes.name: Nepal Police, APF and Nepal Army entry
routes.entry: SEE for ranks, +2 or Bachelor for officer cadets
routes.about: Fitness, written, interview and medical rounds. Officer entry is through the Public Service Commission or the Army cadet process. Notices are published a few times a year.

routes.name: A Levels (Cambridge) or IB Diploma
routes.entry: SEE or O Levels, subject marks vary
routes.about: International curricula taught in a few private colleges. Accepted by foreign universities directly; Nepali campuses ask for equivalence. Costly, so check scholarship and part-fee options.
routes.exam: Cambridge A Level or IB exams

routes.name: Diploma in Hotel Management or Culinary
routes.about: Front office, kitchen, housekeeping and restaurant service, with internships in hotels and resorts. Cruise, Gulf and Europe hotels hire trained staff.

routes.name: BE Electrical Engineering
routes.about: Power generation, high-voltage transmission, machines and control. Nepal's hydropower projects, NEA and industrial plants hire electrical engineers steadily. IOE Regular seats cost around NPR 63k to 1.2 lakh.

routes.name: BE Mechanical Engineering
routes.about: Hydropower turbines, thermal systems, manufacturing and automotive maintenance. Taught at IOE Pulchowk, Thapathali, Purwanchal, Paschimanchal and KU Dhulikhel.

routes.name: BDS (Dental Surgery)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) with at least 50% or 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Dental care, oral surgery and orthodontics. MEC fixes the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 20.92 lakh (plus materials and hostel), with government scholarship seats through MECEE-BL rank.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BSc MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology)
routes.entry: +2 Science with Biology or CMLT with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Runs pathology, biochemistry, haematology and microbiology diagnostics. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh, with scholarship seats via MECEE-BL.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BPT (Physiotherapy)
routes.entry: +2 Science with Biology or Physiotherapy diploma (50% / 2.4 CGPA)
routes.about: Rehabilitation after injury, surgery and stroke, plus sports medicine. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh. Demand in hospitals, rehab clinics and abroad is strong.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BPH (Public Health)
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology) or health diploma with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Epidemiology, health policy, nutrition and community health management. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh. Local governments, NGOs and UN agencies hire BPH graduates.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BVSc and AH (Veterinary Science)
routes.about: Animal health, livestock and dairy. Government veterinary posts, private farms and feed or drug companies are the main employers.

routes.name: BTTM (Tourism and Travel Management)
routes.about: Tour operation, trekking, aviation ticketing and destination marketing. Tourism is one of Nepal's main earners, so entrepreneurs do well here.

routes.name: BFA (Fine Arts and Design)
routes.about: Painting, sculpture, graphic and interaction design. Studios, ad agencies, game and product teams hire people with a strong portfolio.

routes.name: BSc (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology)
routes.about: A pure science base for research, teaching, data and civil service. Many students pair it with a skill like coding to widen options.

routes.name: MPH (Master of Public Health)
routes.entry: Bachelor in health or related field
routes.about: Programme leadership in health policy, epidemiology and global health. A route into WHO, UNICEF, INGOs and the Ministry of Health.

routes.name: ACCA, CMA or CFA professional route
routes.about: Global finance qualifications you can sit while studying. ACCA is common for audit, CMA for corporate finance and CFA for investment roles.
routes.exam: Exam sessions by the awarding body

routes.name: Banking and finance entry
routes.entry: Bachelor in any field, finance preferred
routes.about: Banks, insurers and finance companies hire trainees through written tests and interviews. Strong numeracy, English and customer skills matter more than the exact degree.

routes.name: Freelance and remote digital work
routes.about: Web, design, writing, video and support work for clients abroad. Income depends on proof of work, English and steady client delivery; no certificate replaces a portfolio.

routes.name: PhD and academic research
routes.about: Research and university teaching. Funded positions exist abroad and through UGC fellowships; unfunded PhDs rarely pay back.
